specs.title: real payroll comparison is read-only, accessible and matches after an explicit posting
duplicate payroll is visibly held and a real posting attempt preserves the ledger
comparison failures are visible and an older response cannot replace a newer label
reviewed repair preserves paid state and grants the identified employee access
cancelling a reviewed repair sends no confirmation
stale payroll state is refused and shows an accessible error in the review
same-name employees retain separate certificates, print details and CSV identifiers
every payroll report shows the real integrity error and disables export
changing year clears export immediately and ignores a late older response
payslip original employee cannot retrieve ambiguous legacy pay
payslip reused employee cannot retrieve ambiguous legacy pay
administrator sees durable export failures, handles status errors and refreshes safely
desktop: wrong password, keyboard login, stock journey and server logout
mobile: 360px layout, core navigation, offline failure and sign out
login forms: labelled controls, keyboard access and axe scan
API attack surface: injection, oversized inputs, CORS and private caching
browser: separate users cannot edit each other’s notes; role changes revoke cookies
browser: message HTML is a non-executable attachment and policy links are usable
browser: uploaded JavaScript cannot execute as a self-hosted script
browser: authenticator enrollment, one-use recovery and mobile factor sign-in
assisted recovery: email-link redemption requires authenticator enrollment before workspace access
recovery cancellation: GET previews are inert and owner confirmation is single-use
website signup retains input after invoice failure and retries the same workspace successfully
signup deadline preserves a committed request identity and retries without duplicate invoice
signup busy response retains fields and the same key for a successful retry
signup refuses null, HTML and wrong-status success without losing request identity
stale admin changes require accessible password + factor confirmation and preserve cancelled work
support submission hides a real storage failure, retains the draft and accepts a corrected retry
